newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA'S CARE REAFFIRMS THE CARE A RATING OF POFL.
newsitem.headline: INDIA'S CARE REAFFIRMS THE CARE A RATING OF POFL.

text.p: Credit Analysis & Research Ltd.(CARE) said on Thursday in a statement that it has reaffirmed the 'CARE A' rating assigned to the fixed deposit programme of Pioneer Overseas Finance Ltd. (POFL) for a limit of 220 million rupees.

During 1996/97 (April-March), the company's focus continued to be in hire purchase financing of plant & machinery. There was only a marginal growth in disbursements and total capital employed remained stagnant.

However, the company improved its profitability margins by reducing operational expenses. Moreover, by bringing down the dividend rate from 20 percent in 1995/96 to 5 percent 1996/97, the company was able to improve its net cash accruals from 15 million rupees in 1995/96 to 18 million rupees in 1996/97.
